FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you really come to me?

Yes. Our service trucks come to your home, office, job site or fleet yard anywhere in Orange County and LA.

Is there a mobile service fee?

Our mobile service fee is $75. In Orange County, we waive it when you buy four new tires. Outside Orange County, the $75 fee applies.

Do you service commercial and fleet vehicles?

Yes. We handle box trucks, trailers, big rigs and heavy equipment, including 17.5", 19.5" and 22.5" tires.

Do you work on Teslas, EVs and Cybertrucks?

Yes. We install EV-rated tires on Teslas and other EVs, plus Cybertruck and luxury fitments.

Are your tires covered by a warranty?

A nationwide warranty is available as an add-on for $15 per tire. It isn’t included automatically, so just ask for it when you book.
